worldFact.locationContext: Tana Toraja highlands, South Sulawesi · Indonesia
worldFact.fact: In Sulawesi's Toraja highlands, a dead relative can stay at home for weeks, months or even years. The family calls them to makula', 'a sick person', and brings them meals each day. A proper funeral needs at least 24 sacrificed buffalo, and at ma'nene' ceremonies families lift their dead out of the tomb to dress them in fresh clothes.
